chunks.section: Handling Common Prospect Objections › What happens if I'm not satisfied with the shortlist presented?
chunks.text:
"What happens if I'm not satisfied with the shortlist presented?"
Response: Nexova offers one additional round of search at no cost if none
of the candidates in the initial shortlist are acceptable, provided the
client has given specific feedback on why they didn't fit.

If, 4 weeks into an executive search, no qualified candidate has been
presented, the assigned consultant must escalate the case to Javier Almeida
(Operations Manager) and proactively notify the client with an action plan.

Ticket #96 "Mobile app crashes on iOS 17 after update" is **Open**. Category: Technical failure; origin: Customer; branch: Central. Opened 2024-01-28, last updated 2024-01-28.

That's a great question, and it's one we've built a safety net for. If none of the candidates on the initial shortlist are a fit, Nexova will conduct one additional round of search at no cost. The only thing we ask is that you provide specific feedback on why they didn't work, so we can refine our approach and hit the mark the second time.

We also have a built-in escalation process: if we're 4 weeks into an executive search and haven't presented a qualified candidate, our Operations Manager, Javier Almeida, gets involved, and we proactively share an action plan with you. So you're never left in the dark.

Does that address your concern? If you'd like, we can set up a quick call to walk through how this would apply to your specific role.
